notes.demo_stream_1: Created 2026-09-13T17:5x via create_stream (sender=recipient=deployer, 5,000,000 real native-XLM stroops, real range proof). Used by the frontend's 'Withdraw Demo Stream' panel via a real nullifier proof hardcoded as REAL_NULLIFIER_PROOF_HEX in frontend/src/soroban.ts. withdraw()'s own auth check (`caller.require_auth()` + `caller == stream.recipient`) means this proof can only ever be successfully submitted by whoever holds the deployer's real Stellar keypair — knowing the proof/nullifier_hash alone (both public once submitted anyway) grants no ability to withdraw. A separate throwaway-secret proof was generated and genuinely spent via CLI first (tx 902139221671d507c26c434de592768d34606ebdb3edd90f358852ba3c19beae, 222222 stroops, withdrawn_amount now reflects this) to confirm the whole withdraw pipeline works end-to-end before wiring the UI. CORRECTION (2026-09-15): an earlier version of this note incorrectly implied the frontend's real secret was never persisted anywhere; it was briefly committed in circuits/build/nullifier/withdraw_input.json by mistake. That file has been regenerated to use the already-spent throwaway secret (999888777666555) instead — see circuits/gen_safe_withdraw_input.mjs — since it reproduces a nullifier that's already used on-chain and is safe to publish. The frontend's real secret itself was never written to any file this repo tracks and remains known only outside version control.
